en: The image features two black-and-white photographs of a European villa or grand house, seen from two different perspectives. The left image shows a garden with trees and a pathway leading to a house, while the right image captures the front façade of a stately building with an arched entrance and several windows, typical of late 19th/early 20th-century German architecture. The reverse side has handwritten German text, a postmark, and a green stamp from the Deutsches Reich era. There is also a prominent blue stamp from a museum in Bad Pyrmont.
